scope: Manual visual review of the 300-icon draft batch against the original catalog, correcting the earlier blanket rejection.
policy: Keep visually distinct alternate drawings even when they share a concept. Reject only identical or very close silhouettes whose differences are limited to spacing, rounding, orientation, or incidental strokes. Raster similarity is a review aid, never the deletion rule.
